$comment: The declared copy that check:review-workflows reads (review-policy#review-md-owns-lanes, #copilot-requested, #copilot-never-blocks, #tier-informs; docs/specs/adr-batch10-enforcers.spec.md, WS1). 'lanes' lists every review lane REVIEW.md's table must name, with the file or directory that carries it, or 'external' and why nothing in the tree does; 'nonLaneWorkflows' accounts for each other workflow file, so a new review workflow cannot appear unrecorded. 'whenFrom: on' marks the one row whose When cell is derived from the workflow's on: block. 'tierTokens' is what a reader of the review tier looks like, held here as data so that the gate's own source names none of it and is not itself a reader; 'tierReaders' is the complete list of readers, each with the reason it may read the tier. A new entry is a reviewed edit.
